executive.name: Executive Suite, sea view with lounge access

info.check_in: Check-in is from 2 pm. Early check-in from 10 am costs LKR 8,000, if a room is ready.
info.check_out: Check-out is by 12 noon. Late check-out until 4 pm costs LKR 10,000.
info.breakfast: Breakfast is included in every room rate, served from 6.30 to 10.30 am at the Lagoon restaurant.
info.airport: A car from Bandaranaike International Airport costs LKR 9,500 each way, for up to three guests. Book it at least 24 hours ahead.
info.parking: Parking is free for guests, in the basement.
info.pool: The rooftop pool is open from 7 am to 9 pm. Towels are at the pool.
info.cancellation: Cancelling is free until 48 hours before check-in. After that, the first night is charged.
info.children: Children under 6 stay free in their parents' room. An extra bed costs LKR 6,000 a night.
info.pets: Pets are not allowed, except assistance dogs.
info.wifi: Wi-Fi is free everywhere in the hotel.
